_meta.notice: REVIEW WITH A MEDICAL SOURCE BEFORE RELEASE
_meta.description: Curated mapping of plain visual/imaging observation categories to 2-4 common potential conditions with neutral descriptions. For educational and informational purposes only. Not a medical diagnosis.

RAISED_SKIN_AREA.reviewStatus: REVIEW WITH A MEDICAL SOURCE BEFORE RELEASE

possibleConditions.name: Seborrheic keratosis
possibleConditions.description: A very common non-cancerous skin growth that often appears warty or slightly elevated.

possibleConditions.name: Benign nevus (mole)
possibleConditions.description: A common collection of pigment cells forming a small, elevated spot.

possibleConditions.name: Viral wart (verruca)
possibleConditions.description: A common harmless skin elevation caused by localized viral infection.

possibleConditions.name: Dermatofibroma
possibleConditions.description: A firm, benign bump in the skin that often occurs following minor irritation.

REDDENED_AREA.reviewStatus: REVIEW WITH A MEDICAL SOURCE BEFORE RELEASE

possibleConditions.name: Contact dermatitis
possibleConditions.description: Localized skin irritation or inflammation triggered by an external substance.

possibleConditions.name: Mild localized eczema
possibleConditions.description: A common inflammatory skin pattern causing dry, red, or irritated areas.

possibleConditions.name: Superficial folliculitis
possibleConditions.description: Mild inflammation of surface hair follicles presenting as small red marks.

DARKER_PATCH.reviewStatus: REVIEW WITH A MEDICAL SOURCE BEFORE RELEASE

possibleConditions.name: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation
possibleConditions.description: Temporary localized darkening of the skin following a minor cut, scrape, or rash.

possibleConditions.name: Solar lentigo (sun spot)
possibleConditions.description: A flat, darker spot resulting from ultraviolet sun exposure.

possibleConditions.name: Pigmented mole (nevus)
possibleConditions.description: A typical concentration of melanocytes producing a darker area.

TEXTURE_VARIATION.reviewStatus: REVIEW WITH A MEDICAL SOURCE BEFORE RELEASE

possibleConditions.name: Actinic keratosis
possibleConditions.description: A rough, scaly patch on sun-exposed skin that should be evaluated by a healthcare professional.

possibleConditions.name: Xerosis (dry skin)
possibleConditions.description: Dry surface skin leading to flaking or localized roughness.

possibleConditions.name: Mild localized plaque
possibleConditions.description: A chronic scaly skin pattern presenting as thickened patches.

TISSUE_DENSITY_VARIATION.reviewStatus: REVIEW WITH A MEDICAL SOURCE BEFORE RELEASE

possibleConditions.name: Atelectasis (partial lung collapse)
possibleConditions.description: Temporary partial collapse or under-inflation of small airway regions.

possibleConditions.name: Focal parenchymal consolidation
possibleConditions.description: Accumulation of inflammatory cellular fluid within lung tissue.

possibleConditions.name: Reactive inflammatory change
possibleConditions.description: Localized immune or inflammatory response to recent airway irritation.

NODULE_LIKE_DENSITY.reviewStatus: REVIEW WITH A MEDICAL SOURCE BEFORE RELEASE

possibleConditions.name: Benign granuloma
possibleConditions.description: A small area of tissue healing, frequently residual from past resolved inflammation.

possibleConditions.name: Intrapulmonary lymph node
possibleConditions.description: A normal, healthy lymph node located within the lung parenchyma.

possibleConditions.name: Hamartoma
possibleConditions.description: A benign, non-cancerous lung growth composed of disorganized normal tissue.

possibleConditions.name: Solitary pulmonary nodule
possibleConditions.description: A discrete round density on imaging that requires clinical review and follow-up.

ASYMMETRY_AREA.reviewStatus: REVIEW WITH A MEDICAL SOURCE BEFORE RELEASE

possibleConditions.name: Anatomical variation
possibleConditions.description: A benign difference in contour or shape between paired structures.

possibleConditions.name: Dependent fluid accumulation
possibleConditions.description: Gravity-related pooling of fluid depending on patient positioning.

possibleConditions.name: Post-infectious scarring
possibleConditions.description: Fibrotic tissue remaining after a previous chest or lung infection.

FOCAL_OPACITY.reviewStatus: REVIEW WITH A MEDICAL SOURCE BEFORE RELEASE

possibleConditions.name: Pneumonitis or focal pneumonia
possibleConditions.description: Infectious or non-infectious inflammatory response in lung tissue.

possibleConditions.name: Mucus plugging
possibleConditions.description: A temporary accumulation of secretions in an airway causing localized density.

possibleConditions.name: Localized pulmonary contusion
possibleConditions.description: Tissue response following minor chest trauma or coughing.

GENERAL_OBSERVATION.reviewStatus: REVIEW WITH A MEDICAL SOURCE BEFORE RELEASE

possibleConditions.name: Benign localized tissue change
possibleConditions.description: A common visual feature frequently seen during standard imaging evaluations.

possibleConditions.name: Reactive or post-inflammatory change
possibleConditions.description: Tissue responding to temporary inflammation, irritation, or healing.
